data.example_send_text_code:
curl -X POST https://tu-dominio.com/api/v1/device/send \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer lnk_tu_token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "to": "5212221234567",
    "type": "text",
    "content": "¡Hola! Tu pedido #1234 está listo para recoger."
  }'
data.example_send_image_code:
curl -X POST https://tu-dominio.com/api/v1/device/send \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer lnk_tu_token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "to": "5212221234567",
    "type": "image",
    "content": "https://tu-sitio.com/promo.jpg",
    "caption": "¡Aprovecha nuestra promoción!"
  }'
